note: USFS Cherokee NF, Tellico Plains Ranger District. Small primitive campground with gravel pads beside the upper Tellico River on paved Tellico River Rd (FR 210), about 17 mi above the ranger station. Picnic table, fire ring, lantern post. Pad lengths not posted; neighbouring campgrounds on this road take rigs to about 25-26 ft. Opened May 22 in 2025. --Claude
summary: Big Oak Cove: FS page + alerts, rec.gov facility, OSM, Esri, 3DEP read. Open ('Site Open'); $10, 11 sites, vault toilets, no water; FCFS only with Scan & Pay. Waterfront riverfront -> creekside recommended: the Tellico here is a narrow stream under closed canopy, well under 30 m; pads ~1.5-3 m above it within ~15-25 m. Elevation 834 -> ~771.
flags: WATERFRONT riverfront -> CREEKSIDE (size rule, not --AWH): the Tellico River at the campground is hidden under closed canopy on Esri, a narrow dark strip only a few metres wide where it shows - well under ~30 m. The road and pads run along the NE bank: 3DEP 771.9 m at 35.26385,-84.08680 vs the river 770.2 m at 35.263824,-84.086959 (~15 m, ~1.7 m rise) - passes the creekside walk-down test.
